blocks.x: See disruption coming, re-plan before it lands.
The problem this solution exists for
Multi-tier supply is opaque; disruptions surface as missed deliveries; re-planning takes weeks; ESG/provenance obligations add evidence duties.

We build the risk-sensing control tower: multi-tier supplier telemetry, disruption early warning with scenario playbooks, autonomous re-planning within policy, and the provenance/evidence layer for regulated claims.

The solution runs on Achala Nexus and Achala Ledger: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.  Shared truth with regulatory teeth — permissioned networks that survive supervision.
How it runs in an engagement

challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.

blocks.x: Data readiness matters more than data volume: the diagnostic phase surfaces gaps, and the design phase prices them — no program pretends the estate is cleaner than it is.

blocks.x: Deployed across Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial, Retail & Consumer Goods, Agriculture & Food Systems, Energy & Utilities. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
